title: Deep Neural Mixed Models for Nonlinear Longitudinal Prediction with Subject-Specific Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2610.15323v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Longitudinal health data often exhibit within-subject correlation, subject-specific heterogeneity, and complex nonlinear predictor--response relationships that may not be adequately captured by conventional mixed models. We propose a Deep Generalized Neural Network Mixed Model (DGNMM) that extends the GLMM framework by using a deep neural network to learn nonlinear population-level relationships while incorporating directly trainable, regularized subject-specific effects to capture individual heterogeneity. The model is estimated using prediction-oriented stochastic optimization with separate regularization of the neural-network parameters and subject-specific effects. This formulation allows us to investigate when increased nonlinear representation capacity provides additional predictive benefit in the presence of subject-specific heterogeneity. A simulation study varies population-level nonlinearity and subject-specific heterogeneity

translated_title: 面向具有个体特异异质性的非线性纵向预测的深度神经网络混合模型
translated_abstract: 纵向健康数据通常表现出个体内部相关性、个体特异异质性以及复杂的非线性预测变量—响应关系，这些特征可能无法被传统混合模型充分捕捉。我们提出了一种深度广义神经网络混合模型（DGNMM），该模型扩展了GLMM框架：利用深度神经网络学习总体水平的非线性关系，同时引入可直接训练并经过正则化的个体特异效应来捕捉个体异质性。该模型采用面向预测的随机优化方法进行估计，并对神经网络参数和个体特异效应分别施加正则化。这一建模方式使我们能够探究在存在个体特异异质性的情况下，增强的非线性表征能力何时能带来额外的预测收益。一项模拟研究通过改变总体水平非线性程度和个体特异异质性程度……
tldr: 提出深度广义神经网络混合模型（DGNMM），通过将深度神经网络与可训练的正则化个体特异效应相结合来扩展GLMM框架，从而在存在个体异质性的纵向健康数据中提升非线性预测能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Deep Generalized Neural Network Mixed Model (DGNMM) that extends the GLMM framework by combining a deep neural network for nonlinear population-level relationships with trainable, regularized subject-specific effects, improving longitudinal prediction in the presence of individual heterogeneity.
